_comment: Hand-authored figure questions for modules whose drafted predictPrompt phrased the ask imperatively. The scenario stays in `figureSetup`; this is the single interrogative sentence the prediction gate shows. Lint enforces: interrogative, one sentence, and it must not carry its own answer.
ai-failure-ux: Which two things go wrong — one the user sees immediately, one only on the invoice?
api-errors: Where should this 409 actually land, and which single field decides it?
found-connection: How much sooner does the 30KB document finish arriving?
found-event-loop: In what order do D, A, B and C run, and how many paints occur?
found-http-cache: Where does the stale copy live, and which header on which resource is at fault?
found-http-multiplexing: Which pair swaps order relative to a lossless link?
found-memory: How many DOM subtrees stay retained, and which single line frees all of them?
found-nav-lifecycle: Where is the missing second spent, and can the backend team recover any of it?
found-origins-credentials: Which gate failed, and would changing the server's status code help?
found-render-pipeline: Does the animation get smoother, and by what mechanism?
found-responsiveness: What is the new p75 INP, and what would you need to know to answer at all?
found-workers: How much main-thread blocking time did you remove, and where does the remainder show up?
incl-i18n-arch: Which locale breaks first, and what does the count 21 do there that 2 does not?
incl-rtl-bidi: Which three things break first, and which one would a pseudo-localization pass have missed?
meta-frontend-estimation: Which of network transfer, parse, DOM construction or heap overruns its own budget by the widest margin?
perf-animation: What does each animation look like during the 400ms block, and immediately after it?
perf-bundles: Which mechanism still explains the 180KB of growth?
perf-virtualization: Why does trackpad scrolling get choppier after virtualizing?
sec-embedding-isolation: Which one line of attacker JavaScript escapes that sandbox, and what does it reach?
sec-supply-chain: Does the malicious script run, get blocked, or silently break the feature it powers?
sec-token-storage: In which design does holding the token in memory still cost the user the next 30 days?
sec-xss-sinks: Which single browser behaviour turns that approved string back into executable markup?
state-invalidation: During exactly which interval is the badge wrong, and which mechanism actually fixes it?
state-taxonomy: Which of the three failures fires first in production?
ui-beyond-dom: Which pipeline stages actually run per frame, and does canvas win at 10,000 items?
ui-container-queries: What renders when a card queries its own inline-size?
ui-data-grid: Which of the four fixes removes the white bands, and what is a white band physically?
ui-declarative-motion: What does the user see during those 800ms?
ui-interaction-patterns: At exactly what moment does the drag break on a desktop mouse?
ui-overlay-layer: What does the VoiceOver user reach after swiping past the last control?
ui-perceived-speed: Does the median user perceive the app as faster or slower than with no indicator at all?
ui-stacking-context: Where does the modal's backdrop actually cover, and does the modal paint above the header?
